ai.consent.change: Once it is on, the promise that everything you enter stays on this device no longer holds for the conversation's text:
ai.consent.kept: Neither this service nor the AI provider keeps the conversation; the app holds it in memory only while you use it, never on the device, in a backup or in a result.
ai.consent.never: Your name, birth data, earlier results and notes are never sent. Please do not type your name or contact details in the conversation.
ai.consent.sent: What you type in the conversation is sent, only while you use it, to this service and to the AI provider we name, to pick out symptoms that you then confirm one by one.
ai.consent.title: Turn on AI help?
ai.consent.withdraw: You can turn it off at any time in Settings; the questions without AI give the same result.
ai.entry.body: Talk with AI help: it picks out symptoms for you to confirm one by one, and the questions then ask about what the conversation did not cover.
ai.entry.offer: Would you rather describe it in your own words? AI help can be turned on in Settings.
ai.entry.title: Describe it in your own words (AI help)

ai.privacy.consent.until: Until you turn it off or erase everything

ai.reopened.body: What you wrote in the conversation may concern a situation that needs a doctor first. Please answer the open questions again; the conversation will wait for you.

ai.settings.intro: AI help lets you describe your complaints in your own words; you then confirm the symptoms it picks out, and the same rules as before decide the result. It is off unless you turn it on; without it the app works exactly as before.
ai.settings.off: AI help is off; nothing more is sent.
ai.settings.photos: Looking at photos of the tongue and face is not available.
ai.settings.status.off: The service is switched off for now; the questions work as usual.
ai.settings.status.unreachable: The service cannot be reached right now; the questions work as usual.

ai.talk.error.rate: That was quick: please wait a moment before sending again.
ai.talk.error.service: The service did not answer; try again, or continue with the questions.
